# Parser bundle provenance

Selected unmodified files from `@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm@0.3.1` (MIT), published
by the Visual Studio Code team, are included here: `tree-sitter.js` (renamed to
`tree-sitter.cjs` for Node's module loader), and with one trailing space removed), the core WASM, and TypeScript, TSX,
JavaScript and Python grammar WASM. The package tarball's SHA-1 is
`81d046fb37c09a1e950a20a1f233e8d868d76c77`; the source repository is
https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-tree-sitter-wasm . The package's MIT license
is reproduced in this directory. This is a build-time provenance reference;
Grove performs no runtime network check or download.
